scenes.text: Division undoes multiplication: if 7 times 8 equals 56, then 56 divided by 7 equals 8 and 56 divided by 8 equals 7.
Calculate 16 divided by 4. The answer is 4. 4 times 4 equals 16.
A club at a science exhibition shares 21 pencils equally among 7 teams. How many per team? Pause the video and think.
A club at a science exhibition shares 21 pencils equally among 7 teams. How many per team? The answer is 3. 7 times 3 equals 21.
